concerns.text: FR-008 and US-2 require executing the original AXPO agent or a 'cached simulation' of it to generate ground-truth outcomes. T008-impl-cache implements a deterministic hash-based mock (`hash(problem_id) % 100 < 40`) which fabricates data rather than simulating the agent. This task does not cover the requirement to generate valid ground truth, leaving FR-008 unimplemented.

FR-007 mandates a hard 5-hour timeout and 7 GB memory limit enforcement. T004-ext implements the logic in `resource_tracker.py`, but there is no task explicitly covering the *integration* or *invocation* of this tracker within the main execution flow (`run_diagnostic.py` or the services) to ensure the limits are actually enforced during the US1/US2/US3 runs. The task creates the tool but does not cover the requirement to use it.

FR-010 requires the system to halt if N < 30 *after* all filtering (missing thinking prefixes in T017, missing problem_type in T005-ext). T024 checks sample size, but there is no task explicitly ensuring this check occurs *after* the filtering steps in T017 and T005-ext have completed. Without a specific task linking the post-filter count to the FR-010 halt condition, the requirement is not fully covered.

SC-002 requires measuring accuracy against a held-out test set and reporting it separately. T032-persist creates `results/classifier_metrics.json`, but the task description does not explicitly mandate the schema or the separation of training vs. test metrics in the output file, leaving the 'separately' requirement of SC-002 potentially unimplemented in the artifact.
